look_here_first: Compare the flower and fruit together: this annual has a mostly glabrous flowering spike with white 12–19 mm four-petaled flowers, crimson anthers, and a short chunky nutlike fruit with four major lobes/ridges.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: vegetative stems/leaves villous but flowering spike essentially glabrous

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: radial white flowers about 12–19 mm across

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: short indehiscent 4-sided/4-lobed nutlike fruit about 6–7 mm
